# temps_project_secret (Resource)

An encrypted secret of a project, injected into its deployments.

The value is write-only on the server: the provider keeps the configured value in state and cannot detect a change made outside Terraform. Every update sends the whole scope, because Temps treats an omitted scope as "every environment".

Import with `<project_id>/<secret_id>`; the value cannot be imported and is set again on the next apply.

Required API key permissions: `environments:read`, `environments:create`, `environments:write`, `environments:delete`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "stripe_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}

data "temps_environment" "production" {
  project_id = temps_project.web.id
  name       = "production"
}

# Only production deployments receive the key.
resource "temps_project_secret" "stripe" {
  project_id      = temps_project.web.id
  key             = "STRIPE_SECRET_KEY"
  value           = var.stripe_key
  environment_ids = [data.temps_environment.production.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Secret name, for example `API_TOKEN`. Changing it replaces the secret.
- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project. Changing it replaces the secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Secret value.

### Optional

- `compose_services` (Set of String) Docker Compose services that receive the secret. Empty (the default) means all of them. Temps does not check that the services exist.
- `environment_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the environments the secret applies to. Empty (the default) applies it to every environment of the project. Two secrets with the same key cannot share an environment.
- `include_in_preview` (Boolean) Also inject the secret into preview environments.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Numeric secret ID.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import temps_project_secret.stripe 3/12
```
